about.title: About us
about.lead: A Yangon dumpling house for handmade plates, cooked when you order them.
about.body: မေဓါဝီဖက်ထုပ်အိုးကပ်ဆိုင် folds dumplings by hand and finishes them in the pan, in broth, or with mala heat. We keep the kitchen small and the menu focused: signatures you can taste, made fresh every day.
about.value1Body: Wrappers and fillings are prepared in our kitchen — not brought in ready-made.
about.value2Body: Each plate starts when you ask for it, so the bottoms stay crisp and the broth stays clear.
about.value3Body: Pan-fried dumplings, Sichuan mala, and noodles — the house in three tastes.
